hooks.command: FILE_PATH=$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '/\.env$|\.env$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env contains secrets and must not be edited' >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\(.*\)"/\1/p'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qi 'git commit' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qi 'co-authored-by'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Co-Authored-By is prohibited' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'git (push\s+(-f|--force)|reset\s+--hard|clean\s+-fd?)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive git command requires manual execution' >&2; exit 2; fi
